research_questions.question: How should a repair provider separate parts, delivered labor and an assurance warranty at close?
research_questions.scope: Selected US other-services residual branches in NAICS 811, 812, 813 and 814; illustrative 2026 close. US GAAP, federal tax and consumer-protection routes remain separate. No whole-subsector sufficiency is asserted.
research_questions.answer: Tie the work order, parts issue and technician completion to the delivered service; present separately sold service warranties as distinct promised services, while an assurance warranty remains an obligation estimate under the stated facts. Customer-owned equipment remains custody, not provider inventory.

question_rows.question: How should a repair provider separate parts, delivered labor and an assurance warranty at close?
question_rows.scope: Selected US other-services residual branches in NAICS 811, 812, 813 and 814; illustrative 2026 close. US GAAP, federal tax and consumer-protection routes remain separate. No whole-subsector sufficiency is asserted.
question_rows.answer: Tie the work order, parts issue and technician completion to the delivered service; present separately sold service warranties as distinct promised services, while an assurance warranty remains an obligation estimate under the stated facts. Customer-owned equipment remains custody, not provider inventory.

question_rows.scope: Selected US other-services residual branches in NAICS 811, 812, 813 and 814; illustrative 2026 close. US GAAP, federal tax and consumer-protection routes remain separate. No whole-subsector sufficiency is asserted.

question_rows.scope: Selected US other-services residual branches in NAICS 811, 812, 813 and 814; illustrative 2026 close. US GAAP, federal tax and consumer-protection routes remain separate. No whole-subsector sufficiency is asserted.
question_rows.answer: Record the pre-need receipt as a separate unearned or custody population under the stated provider facts, track any restricted or administered funds separately, recognize only the selected completed milestone, and retain the consumer contract and price-list evidence.

question_rows.question: How should a membership or religious organization separate dues benefits from contribution and restricted-program amounts?
question_rows.scope: Selected US other-services residual branches in NAICS 811, 812, 813 and 814; illustrative 2026 close. US GAAP, federal tax and consumer-protection routes remain separate. No whole-subsector sufficiency is asserted.
question_rows.answer: Allocate the stated membership receipt between exchange benefits and contribution based on the documented benefits, keep donor-restricted support separate, release it only for the stated program spend, and retain a defensible natural-to-functional expense allocation.

question_rows.question: How should a household employer control reimbursements and household asset custody alongside payroll?
